item.title: Govt U-turn; Sanchar Saathi pre-installation scrapped amid opposition attack
item.description: The Ministry of Communications has withdrawn its mandate to pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on all smartphones, citing rapid user adoption, even as political debate intensifies over privacy, surveillance concerns, and cyber safety in India. item.title: For Pakistan, Video Game Clips Became a Substitute for Real Naval Power!
item.description: Google reveals how fake naval combat videos, often sourced from video games, spread during India–Pakistan tensions, creating a “virtual navy” that misleads audiences and fuels misinformation online.
